question: Which among the following is a famous festival of Maharashtra, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gudi Padva.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Hindu New Year**, known in **Maharashtra **as **Gudi Padwa,** in** Andhra Pradesh and Telangana** as **Ugadi**, and in **other parts of India** as **Chaitra Navratri.**
 
• Gudi Padwa is a major festival in Maharashtra, but it is also celebrated in Goa, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and some parts of Gujarat and Rajasthan.
 
• The event is held on the** first day of Chaitra month,** which is the first month in the Hindu Panchangam calendar, and often takes place in** March or Apri**l.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The largest celebration in the Indian state of **Kerala **is **Onam**.

 
 
• The Onam Festival commemorates the return of the mythical **King Mahabali** and takes place during the Malayali month of Chingam (Aug–Sep).
 
• The** ten-day Onam Carnival** showcases the finest aspects of Keralan customs and culture.
 
• Kerala's harvest festival, Onam, is known for its elaborately decorated **Pookalam**, delicious **Onasadya**, magnificent **Snake Boat Race**, and unique **Kaikottikali dance**, among other amazing events.
 
 
 
• One of the most important festivals in India is **Chhath Puja.**
 
 
• The majority of **Bihar**, **Uttar Pradesh**, and some **regions of Nepal** commemorate this event.
 
• On the **sixth day** of the month of **Kartika**, the festival begins.
 
• The **four-day celebration** is devoted to **worshiping the Sun** in order to ask for his blessing and to offer prayers for the family's continued prosperity and health.
 
• On this auspicious day, people pray to Lord Sun and immerse themselves in the Ganga's sacred waters.
 
• The day celebrates the benevolent act of Lord Sun and his wife for granting this beautiful life on the earth
